name: AdamantQ
description: AdamantQ is a Swedish quantum technology company based in Lund that develops chip-scale quantum sensing and timing devices using crystal defects within synthetically grown diamonds. Its primary product, the Quantum Diamond Atomic Clock (QDi.AC), provides a compact frequency reference with exceptional timing holdover for applications in GPS receivers, inertial navigation systems, and network infrastructure.

products.name: QDi.AC Quantum Diamond Atomic Clock
products.description: Chip-scale frequency reference using diamond crystal defects for GPS, navigation, and network timing

highlights: Uses nitrogen-vacancy defects in synthetically grown diamonds for quantum sensing
